prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: step 3 of a four-image digital-product series — Test, fix, repeat.
Input image 1 is the primary character/style reference. Input images 2 and 3 are continuity references for the exact happy browser mascot, clean digital-product studio, bright lighting, scale, camera height, restrained monochrome palette, and premium ink finish. Create a new scene.

The mascot has one rectangular browser body, one black header bar with exactly three evenly spaced cream circular controls, an alert happy expression, exactly two continuous black rubber-hose arms, exactly two white four-finger gloves, exactly two legs, and exactly two black shoes. Show the entire mascot from top edge through both shoes with every connection visible.

Style: premium clean 1930s animation-cel editorial illustration, warm ivory paper, rich black ink, restrained charcoal wash, confident consistent contours, sparse hatching, subtle paper tooth, bright studio light, crisp contrast around face and hands. No muddy aging, sadness, fatigue, malfunction, or stock clip-art look.

Format: standalone 3:2 landscape homepage process image. Large readable digital interface props and one dominant action. Character and props occupy about 72 percent of image height, with calm negative space, simple floor line, no panel border, and an 8 percent safe margin. Nothing important is cropped or hidden.

Constraints: no words, letters, numerals, captions, labels, logos, watermark, pseudo-text, or illegible UI copy. Devices are non-anthropomorphic with no face or limbs. No other character. No wires, cords, cables, hoses, pipes, dangling lines, exposed electronics, gears, gauges, servers, robots, bridges, plants, tailoring, conveyor belts, toolbenches, floating objects, or unexplained machinery. No extra, missing, fused, malformed, detached, cropped, or hidden limbs, gloves, fingers, facial features, screens, or props. Nothing intersects another object.
Scene: The happy browser mascot stands full-body between one small upright smartphone held securely in its left glove and one larger landscape display on a simple solid pedestal to its right. Both devices show the same clean text-free interface: one header block, two balanced content cards, and one large rounded action button, adapted clearly to their different screen sizes. The mascot’s right glove presses the large action button on the bigger display while its eyes compare the two layouts. The expression is upbeat, focused, and satisfied by the careful test. Both arms remain separate, short, and easy to trace; both legs and both shoes are unobstructed. Exactly one phone, one display, one solid pedestal. No stylus, paper, checklist, arrows, error symbols, warning symbols, broken UI, or extra props.
